---
title: Connect Claude to Slack
roles: all
item: I1
action: |
  1. Open Claude, go to Settings, then Connectors, and connect Slack.
  2. Give your own Claude this prompt. It posts in your private channel with the copilot.
     ```
     Using your Slack connector, post a short welcome message to the private Slack channel with ID {channelName}. I am already a member of that channel. Use the channel ID, not a name search.
     ```
check: I tick this step when I see the message from Claude. If I do not, click I did it and confirm.
---
Open Claude, go to Settings, then Connectors, and connect Slack. Then mention Claude in a channel.
